Rapid processing, filtering and aggregation is required to ensure timely reaction and actual information in user interfaces. This session introduces Apache Kafka as the scalable event bus that takes care of the events as they flow in and Kafka Streams for the streaming analytics. Both Java and Node applications are demonstrated that interact with Kafka and leverage Server Sent Events and WebSocket channels to update the Web UI in real time.
